After navigating to Git Sync, you can explore the dashboards synced from your Git repository. The dashboard list displays each dashboard's current sync state, helping you identify which dashboards are synchronized and which require action.

To view synced dashboards in a repository, complete the following steps:

1. In the Git Sync page, click a repository name to view its dashboards.

1. Review the list of synced dashboards and their sync state indicators.

   Each dashboard displays a sync state badge showing whether it's synced, modified, out of sync, or in conflict.

1. Click a dashboard name to view its details and sync history.

   The dashboard details page shows commit information, recent changes, and available sync actions.

The dashboard list displays with sync state indicators showing which dashboards are synced, modified, or out of sync. You can use these indicators to prioritize which dashboards need synchronization actions.

In the next milestone, you'll learn how to manage dashboard sync states.
